title_en: Report online money fraud fast on 1930
law: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal and Helpline 1930, Ministry of Home Affairs (I4C)
rule_plain: If you lose money to an online fraud, call 1930 at once. It is a free national helpline that works 24 hours a day, every day. Quick reporting helps stop the money from reaching the fraudster. You can also report any cyber crime on cybercrime.gov.in.
what_you_can_do: Call 1930 as soon as you see the fraud.
Report the crime on www.cybercrime.gov.in (Report Cyber Crime, then Register a Complaint).
You can also report online harassment and identity theft there. Your State police will act on it.
Track your complaint on the same portal.
